label: CONTRIBUTING.md#Pull request process
title: CONTRIBUTING.md#Pull request process
summary: Fork the repo and create a branch from main. Keep changes focused — one logical change per PR. Match existing code style (no formatter enforced; 2-space indent, single quotes). Open a PR against main with a short description of what and why.
